parameters.name: DestType
parameters.description: The type of the destination. Valid values are `OCEANBASE` for OceanBase, `KAFKA` for Kafka, `ROCKETMQ` for RocketMQ, `POLARDB_X_1` or `POLARDB_X_2` for PolarDB-X, and `TIDB` for TiDB.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the worker instance.

parameters.name: OnlyBindable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to list only bindable instances. The default value is `true`.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return for paginated queries.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page for paginated queries.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: The type of the source. Valid values are `OCEANBASE` for OceanBase, `KAFKA` for Kafka, `ROCKETMQ` for RocketMQ, `POLARDB_X_1` or `POLARDB_X_2` for PolarDB-X, and `TIDB` for TiDB.
